# ZiDevTools Inspect 0.1.5 candidate

Dense flat numeric YAML sequences and maps can convert within the same Worker budget. The eight tools, profiles, 8 KiB input, and 48 KiB output limits are unchanged. Conversion still requires unique keys and lossless numbers. Mixed and nested YAML uses the general parser and can exhaust the existing budget.

A separate Worker receipt covers the three previously failing documents and two controls. Portable fixture bytes, the View, and the licenses come from the verified 0.1.4 package. The standalone converter is unchanged. This candidate is unsigned.
